violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw fish stored next to veggie rolls in WIR and cream cheese stored in a container with raw salmon.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM relocated veggie rolls to another cooler, and relocated cream cheese to the top shelf with all RTE food items.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the Chlorine solution was measured more than 400 ppm in sanitizer bucket. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of Chlorine solution at 50-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. CFM prepared a new sanitizer bucket at 200 ppm

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Observed buckets of soy sauce and boxes of oil on the floor
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CFM will elevate soy sauce and boxes of oil using approved shelving units.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Lockers, Provided
violations.observation: Lockers or other suitable facilities are not provided for employees clothing and other possessions. Observed jackets, bags, and purses hanging on the bags in box soda dispenser in the back kitchen
violations.corrective_action: Provide proper storage facilities for employees' personal belongings to prevent contamination of food, food equipment, and food contact surfaces. CFM will provide a designated space for employees' personal belongings.

out_items.name: Compliance with variance, specialized process, HACCP

violations.title: HACCP Plan, Procedures to Monitor Critical ControlPoints
violations.observation: Records of the procedures for monitoring critical control points are not being maintained.
violations.corrective_action: CFM performed test in front of EHS and record the pH on the log. EHS reviewed HACCP with the CFM and provide education where was needed.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction, Farm-Raised
violations.observation: The farm-raised fish served raw or partially cooked were observed without a written statement from the supplier stating that the fish were raised and fed according to 3-402.11(B)(3). PER MANAGER, THERE ARE THREE VENDORS WHO PROVIDE FISH THAT IS USED FOR SUSHI, BUT THE OPERATOR ONLY HAS ONE PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM ONE VENDOR.
violations.corrective_action: Contact your fish supplier and ask for a written statement stating that the fish were raised in net pens if in open water OR land-based operations AND fed formulated feed that contains no live parasites. FAX a copy of this letter to your inspector and keep this statement on site at the food establishment for 90 days beyond the time of service of the fish. ADVISED THE MANAGER TO CONTACT THE REMAINING TWO VENDORS AND OBTAIN PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FOR FISH ITEMS THAT ARE USED FOR SUSHI DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: ITEMS FROM SUSHI ROLL ON TAKE OUT/CATERING MENU AND LARGE BOARD MENU. - SALMON AVOCADO - SPICY SALMON - SALMON ROLL - TUNA - SPICY TUNA
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PER MANAGER THE UPDATED MENU IS ORDERED AND WILL ARRIVE AT THE FACILITY IN FEW DAYS. ADVISED THE MANAGER TO MANUALLY PLACE ASTERISKS ON THE ITEMS LISTED ABOVE UNTIL THE UPDATED MENU ARRIVES.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage-Personal Care Items
violations.observation: Observed painkiller (medicine) and a cream stored in such a way that they could contaminate prep tables and drink area in the back prep area.
violations.corrective_action: All employees' personal care items shall be stored in a way that prevents the contamination of food and food contact surfaces through improper labeling or storage.THE MANAGER MOVED THOSE ITEMS FROM FOOD PREP AREAS DURING INSPECTION. ADVISED THE MANAGER TO KEEP PERSONAL CARE ITEMS UNDER THE POS SYSTEM OR AWAY FROM FOOD PREP AREAS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: MULTIPLE BOTTLES OF OIL IN CLEAR AT COOKLIE
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. INSTRUCTED THE OPERATOR TO LABEL THE OILD BOTTLES DURING INSPECTION. QUICKWAY JAPANESE HIBACHI (Inspection Date: 05/29/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Rice scoops in water at room temperature.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. THE MANGER INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE RICE SCOOPS FROM WATER AND SANITIZER PRIOR TO KEEPING IT DRY DURING INSPECTION.
